messages:
Anya (DemandGen): quick note 1: CloudZen asked about a co-marketed push when their marketplace page goes live. they want a joint blog + 45m webinar + a small paid social boost. need to confirm lead routing and benchmark messaging before we sign off.
Ben (Partnerships): CloudZen date = Dec 6. ask: can we show p95 latency + cost per 100k tokens on Dedicated vs default infra? they want neutral language.
Rae (Product Marketing): agree neutral framing. propose three pillars for comms: predictable p95, unit cost at scale, easy marketplace provisioning. short headline: "Ship production LLM inference with predictable latency via CloudZen Marketplace."
Omar (Integrations): routing plan: add hidden field partner_source=cloudzen_marketplace and utm_source=cloudzen. webhook to Pardot -> SFDC campaign CloudZen_Marketplace. can do by Nov 20.
Jules (Sales Eng): webinar content: 30m partner walkthrough, 10m Redwood demo (routing + canary), 5m ops Q&A. need partner workload sample to reproduce benchmark. I'll add a reproducibility appendix in slides.
Ben (Partnerships): I'll request quote + workload sample. also asked CloudZen about co-funding social spend; awaiting reply.
Anya (DemandGen): owners & deadlines:
- Partner quote (Ben) -> 11/05
- Benchmark narrative (Rae) -> 11/12
- Landing page + hidden fields (Omar) -> 11/20
- Webinar deck (Jules + Rae) -> 11/28
- PR/blog draft (Anya) -> 11/22
ScheduleBot: created event "CloudZen co-marketed webinar rehearsal" on Dec 3, 11:00-11:45 AM PT. Zoom: https://zoom.example.com/meet/cloudzen-rehearsal.
Omar (Integrations): sample webhook payload for Pardot:
```
email={{email}}&first_name={{firstName}}&partner_source=cloudzen_marketplace&utm_source=cloudzen&utm_campaign=cloudzen_launch
```
Rae (Product Marketing): for comms: short headline stat (percent improvement) + appendix with baseline numbers and test conditions (model, batch size, quant). will draft both.
Anya (DemandGen): sweet. once Omar confirms the hidden field and webhook test, I'll spin up the landing and schedule ads. post any edits here. :rocket:
